License: per file (upstream has no top-level licence; see each file's header):
         crt-easymode.slang  "License: GPL" (EasyMode)
         crt-geom.slang      GPL-2.0-or-later (cgwg, Themaister, DOLLS)

         .slang files are the shader source.
Use:     bundled CRT and LCD presets for the runner's `video.shader` setting
         (`crt-easymode`, `crt-geom`, `crt-lottes`, `zfast-lcd`). The runner looks for this folder via
         --shaders-dir, NOSTYRA_SHADERS, `shaders/` next to its exe, or (debug builds)
         this repo path.
